verdict.rationale: Svelte is a compiler and framework, so the core product runs on the user's own machine. It is installed and run locally with `npx sv create`, `npm install` and `npm run dev`, and its source lives in the public sveltejs/svelte GitHub repo. No vendor-hosted service is needed, and SvelteKit's adapter-static lets users deploy built apps on their own infrastructure. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of fully offline, self-managed use.
